edits.new:
Then a load that was refused or rolled back publishes nothing

  Scenario: AC12 A new decision code is a row and the build changes nothing (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given "DOA-2026.11" is in force
    Given a new decision code is added as a row of the decision list in force
    When "U-3101" loads a file that uses the new decision code and "U-3102" approves it
    Then the load is accepted with no change to the code
    Then the new row is stored and the lookup returns the level of that row

  Scenario: AC13 An unauthenticated or unknown-load read of the load is refused with 401 or 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a caller with no authentication
    When the caller asks GET /api/recovery/access/v1/admin/doa-loads/{loadId} for any load
    Then the call is refused with status 401
    Then a call by "U-3101" for a loadId that no load holds answers status 404

  Scenario: AC14 A repeated write with the same Idempotency-Key answers the first answer (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given file "DOA-2026.11" was loaded by "U-3101" with an Idempotency-Key
    When "U-3101" sends the same load again with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then the second call answers the stored answer of the first
    Then no second row set and no second decision-record entry is written
